title: Unmovable
description: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each turn, double the amount gained.
smart_description: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each turn, double the amount gained.
notes: Uses a Counter stack type to track block-gain events from cards. Each turn, the counter tracks how many times the player has gained block from card plays. Only the first block gain per turn (counter = 0) receives the doubling effect. The counter increments with each card-driven block gain and resets at the start of each turn. Does not apply to monsters or non-card block sources.
